messages:
Rhea: Quick heads-up  I pushed a relnotes + changelog draft for the docs site, aiming to publish later today. Need a short snippet sweep and a couple of migration blurbs checked.
Cal: Link?
Rhea: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/branches/relnotes-2801234567 
Marta: Skimming now. Two things jumped out: 1) we added Structured Outputs (experimental) in the features list; 2) a Rust SDK snippet is in the quickstart but I can't verify it.
Ibrahim: For Structured Outputs can we include a 1-line example of a schema-enforced response so users know what to expect? Marketing wants a clear callout that it's experimental.
Rhea: Added this under "New features": "Structured Outputs (experimental) 0: schema-enforced JSON responses for higher-precision parsing" with a short example.
Sanjay: For the example, suggest a tiny schema + explanation: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"},"score":{"type":"number"}}}```
Ava: Also the migration guide needs a note: the prompt template variable changed from `{{user_prompt}}` to `{{input_text}}` in the new template engine. Add a one-liner migration snippet.
Cal: I'll paste the migration snippet: ```yaml
# update templates
old: "User asked: {{user_prompt}}"
new: "User asked: {{input_text}}"
```
Marta: About the Rust SDK: repo shows new crate name `redwood_rs` and constructor `redwood_rs::Client::from_env()`. Can someone confirm the exact snippet we want in quickstart?
Ibrahim: Confirmed. Use this small example: ```rust
use redwood_rs::Client;
let client = Client::from_env();
let res = client.generate("Hello").await?;
```
Rhea: Great  I'll add both the Rust snippet and a short migration note for users upgrading from the unofficial crate.
Docs Bot: Link-check queued for branch relnotes-2801234567  ETA ~3m :gear:
Sanjay: One more: the changelog-generator script occasionally strips anchors from headings which broke a few deep links in the draft -> we should run a local anchor-fix before publishing. I can push a tiny post-processing step.
Ava: Which links are failing in the draft?
Marta: I found `/sdk/rust-auth` -> 404 and `/guides/prompt-templates#deprecated-vars` -> 410. Both show up in the sidebar links.
Docs Bot: Link-check complete: two issues found (`/sdk/rust-auth` 404, `/guides/prompt-templates#deprecated-vars` 410). Suggested fixes: redirect `/sdk/rust-auth` -> `/sdk/rust/authentication` and update anchor for prompt-templates to `#variable-changes`.
Rhea: I'll open redirects + patch PRs. Drafts: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5345 (rust auth redirect) and /pull/5346 (anchor fix + migration blurb).
Sanjay: I'll also add the anchor-fix postprocessor to the changelog tool as a follow-up PR.
Ibrahim: Tiny nit: can we add a changelog bullet that the function-calling API has stabilized and now supports named-args? Users asked for that in support.
Rhea: Added a short bullet: "Function/tool-calling: named-args support (stabilizing) 0; see function-calls guide."
Cal: Marketing sign-off requested that we use "experimental" and "preview (opt-in)" consistently. Use "preview (opt-in)" for any opt-in runtime flags.
Rhea: Done. I used "experimental" for Structured Outputs and "preview (opt-in)" for the fallback routing flag mentioned in the draft.
Marta: Anything else on snippets? I updated the Rust crate path and removed an old `unwrap()` in the example to avoid encouraging panics.
Ava: Docs Bot rerun after PRs?
Docs Bot: Link-check queued for branch relnotes-2801234567 after PRs merge  ETA ~2m :gear:
Sanjay: I'm good to review the small postprocessing PR once it's up.
Rhea: Plan: I merge the redirect + anchor PRs (5345/5346), S anjay lands postprocess change, Docs Bot verifies green, then we publish EOD. Thanks everyone 1f
If more 404s appear ping me here and I'll hotfix the draft. :rocket:
